recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant FHIR-5790 prose unless a future Vocabulary WG decision creates new requirements; more specific binding-currency clarifications should remain attached to their later issue keys.
issue_request: FHIR-5790 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet clarification from DSTU1. It requested clearer documentation for client reuse and currency of value set expansions, whether expansion parameters close ambiguity in generated expansions, and the implications when a binding is evaluated against an expansion rather than only a definition.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 5720, represented in git as 84bd0ed3a8e1dfba7940e5af0244544499bad74f, which edited source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to explain stored expansions, currency/currentness, on-demand terminology server expansion, auditability, client/server reuse, and ValueSet.expansion.identifier reuse.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps valueset=ValueSet in the active resources list and assigns ValueSet to vocab. Later final issues refined the same area: FHIR-13810 added expansion-parameter/version guidance, FHIR-13813 aligned expansion.identifier prose with optional transient identifiers, FHIR-27144 clarified required bindings against expansions and is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-29968 refined extensible-binding expansion/CLD guidance. Direct community searches found no FHIR-5790-specific conflicting record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml documents expansion identifiers, expansion parameters, stored-expansion currentness/reuse, and compose/expansion combinations; source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml and the $expand OperationDefinition describe expansion.parameter recording of inputs and terminology dependencies; source/terminologies.html describes binding conformance in terms of bound value set expansions or equivalent CLD evaluation.
